After copying the plugin into this folder, update the Android module:

1. Open `vendor/contacts_service/android/build.gradle` and inside the `android {}` block add:

   namespace 'com.lukasgit.contacts_service'

2. If the plugin has Kotlin/Gradle configuration that uses the legacy `apply` lines, migrate to the `plugins {}` block per Flutter docs.

3. Run `flutter pub get` from the project root, then `flutter run`.
